text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿 The bird of paradise is a gorgeous choice.

Unfortunately, express shipping isn't available for that plant. Any XL plant (usually over 4 ft, so your 5 ft bird of paradise counts) ships **Standard only**.

Here's what to expect with an XL plant:
- **Shipping method:** Standard only
- **Handling fee:** an extra **$20** for XL plants
- **Standard shipping cost:** $7.95, or free if your order is **$75 or more** (after discounts, before tax)
- **Delivery time:** depends on your zone, from 2–3 business days (under 300 miles from our nearest greenhouse) up to 5–8 business days (over 1,000 miles, or remote and island addresses)
- **Ship days:** live plants ship **Monday to Wednesday only**. Orders placed after 12 noon on Wednesday ship the following Monday.

If you tell me roughly where you're located, I can help you work out which delivery window applies to you.

Please reach out any time if you have more questions. Happy planting! 🌱
